previous_last_sync.summary: Both commits in this range are CI-only changes to the Unit Tests workflow. The extra cylinder fuel trim build jobs now run on master pushes, manual dispatches, and pull requests that touch trim-related files, instead of on every push and pull request. No firmware behavior, tune layout, flashing procedure, or builder workflow changes, so no wiki page needs an update.

decisions.rationale: Maintainer-only CI change. The Unit Tests workflow gains a changes job that decides whether the extra cylinder fuel trim jobs run, and the two trim jobs now depend on it. This affects only when automated test builds execute; firmware behavior, calibration layout, flashing, and build inputs are unchanged, so no reader-facing documentation needs revision.
evidence: `cylinder-fuel-trim` and `cylinder-fuel-trim-arm` jobs gain `needs: changes` and `if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.run_trim == 'true' }}`
Trigger changed from `on: [push,pull_request]` to push/pull_request/workflow_dispatch; no firmware source paths touched

last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU now makes battery-voltage divider calibration an explicit opt-in on fixed-divider boards. A new "Override battery divider coefficient (advanced)" checkbox defaults off, so each board applies its nominal divider; enabling it allows rare manual calibration against a voltmeter, and clearing it restores the board nominal. The stored tune version advances to 20034, so back up and transfer tunes using matching TunerStudio definitions.

decisions.rationale: Core8 no longer forces the battery divider coefficient on every configuration write. The nominal 7.34 value is now applied only in the board defaults path, so a saved or imported Core8 divider value is preserved. This is an intermediate step; the following commit replaces it with the opt-in checkbox, so document the final behavior rather than this intermediate state.
evidence: firmware/config/boards/core8/board_configuration.cpp: removed engineConfiguration->vbattDividerCoeff assignment from setupVbatt() and added it to setBoardDefaultConfiguration()
firmware/CHANGELOG.md: added Core8 battery-voltage divider calibration entry

decisions.rationale: Battery divider calibration is now opt-in on all fixed-divider boards. A new "Override battery divider coefficient (advanced)" checkbox defaults off, so each board applies its nominal divider; enabling it permits manual calibration against a voltmeter, and clearing it restores the board nominal. Invalid or out-of-range values fall back to the nominal. Changes apply after a stopped-engine Burn or after saving and rebooting. The stored tune version advances to 20034, so back up the tune and transfer values with matching TunerStudio definitions from the older schema.
evidence: firmware/controllers/algo/engine_configuration.cpp: new setBoardBatteryVoltageDivider() enforces nominal unless enableBatteryDividerOverride is set, with 0.01-99.0 finite-range fallback
firmware/integration/fome_config.txt: added bit enableBatteryDividerOverride and FLASH_DATA_VERSION bumped 20033 to 20034
firmware/tunerstudio/tunerstudio.template.ini: batteryDialog adds override checkbox, gates coefficient field, and adds batteryDividerHelp
firmware/config/boards/*/prepend.txt: ts_readonly_vbattDividerCoeff changed to "!enableBatteryDividerOverride" across fixed-divider boards
unit_tests/tests/test_battery_voltage_divider.cpp: new tests for nominal enforcement, retained calibration, restore, and invalid fallback
